note: Re-judged 2026-10-21 (independent auditor, second pass after TestAnnounceUnicastWithBlackholeCommunityNarrowsToAgreedPeers was added). RFC 7999 Section 3.1: "In a bilateral peering relationship, use of the BLACKHOLE community MUST be agreed upon by the two networks before advertising it." Both origination verbs and re-advertisement are gated and each is proven both ways. send bgp blackhole (handleAnnounceBlackhole): TestAnnounceBlackholeReachesAnAgreedPeer and TestAnnounceBlackholeReachesAMemberOfADynamicGroup assert the agreed session gets a batch carrying 65535:666; TestAnnounceBlackholeIsWithheldFromAPeerThatDidNotAgree asserts the unagreed peer is outside the selector while the agreed one is served; TestAnnounceBlackholeIsWithheldFromASessionOutsideTheGroup asserts refusal with no batch. send bgp unicast ... community 65535:666 (handleAnnounceUnicast, `sel, err = agreedSelector(...)`): TestAnnounceUnicastWithBlackholeCommunityMeetsTheSameGate asserts refusal and no batch when nobody agreed; TestAnnounceUnicastWithBlackholeCommunityNarrowsToAgreedPeers asserts, with 192.0.2.1 agreed and 192.0.2.2 not, one batch carrying 65535:666 whose selector matches 192.0.2.1 and not 192.0.2.2. The auditor verified the mutant that drops the narrowed selector (`_, err = agreedSelector(...)`, a one-line diff applied by go test -overlay) turns only that unit red, every other announce unit green; the stored records are agreedSelector reverts. Re-advertisement (filter_community egressFilter, blackholeReadvertiseRefused): TestRFC7999ReadvertiseWithheldWithoutAgreement and TestRFC7999ReadvertiseReachesAgreedAndExemptDestinations. Residual weakness, not a gap: the refusal units assert require.Error without errors.Is errNoAgreedPeer.
